response.title: Kabamanda
paragraphs: The open slot should round out a Singles team built around Stealth Rock and Toxic Spikes, with Salamence Mega and Lucario Mega Z as distinct attacking branches. I favored candidates whose sampled moves offer a useful new role or help against the team’s stated Ice and Fighting pressures, while weighing their listed weaknesses and fit signals rather than treating shortlist order as a ranking.

The strongest additions provide either reliable action denial or pivoting alongside their offensive contribution. Several candidates also add useful resistances, but no single fit signal outweighs a candidate’s concrete tradeoff. These recommendations are additions to the open slot, not replacements for an existing teammate.

recommendations.title: Add 누리레느 for action denial and a complementary special attacker.
recommendations.reason: 앙코르 can lock a foe into its last move, giving the team a way to disrupt opposing setup or recovery, while 문포스 and 물거품아리아 provide special attacks. It also resists Fire, Ice, and Fighting according to the supplied fit data; its listed Electric, Grass, and Poison weaknesses are the tradeoff.

recommendations.title: Add 워시로토무 for pivoting and useful defensive coverage.
recommendations.reason: 하이드로펌프 and 10만볼트 provide special attacks, while 볼트체인지 offers pivoting to bring an attacker in safely. The fit data lists Fire and Ice among its resisted team threats, but it is weak to Grass, so it does not solve every defensive concern.

recommendations.title: Add 타부자고 for a setup-capable special attacker.
recommendations.reason: 나쁜음모 gives it a way to raise its Special Attack, and 섀도볼 supplies a selected special attack alongside 골드러시. Its fit data lists Fighting and Fairy among resisted team threats, but also lists Fire as a threat it amplifies, making that defensive tradeoff important.
